Turmeric Powder Wholesale Price for Bulk Buyers

Tradenest Naturals offers competitive turmeric powder wholesale price options for food manufacturers, exporters, distributors, spice traders, and private label brands. Our wholesale turmeric powder uses carefully selected Indian turmeric rhizomes. We clean, dry, grind, and sieve the material for consistent performance. As a result, buyers receive a practical ingredient for seasoning, ready-to-cook products, beverages, nutraceutical formulations, and traditional food applications. Request a quote today for turmeric powder price per kg, sample availability, packaging, and export delivery details. We supply turmeric powder in bulk with flexible specifications. Standard production supports turmeric powder 80 mesh, while other mesh sizes may be available on request. In addition, we can discuss turmeric powder supplier requirements, private label packing, and customer-specific documentation. Our team reviews each inquiry according to the required grade, destination market, order size, and packaging format.

Product Overview

Turmeric powder comes from the dried rhizomes of Curcuma longa. It provides a warm aroma, earthy taste, and characteristic yellow to orange-yellow colour. Food manufacturers use it as a spice, colouring ingredient, and formulation component. Therefore, it fits many products without complex processing. Tradenest Naturals supplies turmeric powder for domestic and international B2B markets. We support standard bulk orders, distributor programs, OEM packing, and private label projects. Moreover, our procurement network helps us plan raw material supply for repeat customers and larger contracts.
  • Indian turmeric powder for food and ingredient applications
  • Standard 80 mesh particle size for smooth blending
  • Natural spice profile with no added colour in the standard product
  • Bulk and customized packaging for domestic and export supply
  • Batch-based quality checks and traceability documentation

Manufacturing and Processing

First, we select mature turmeric rhizomes from suitable Indian growing regions. Next, we clean the raw material to remove soil, stones, and other foreign matter. We then dry the rhizomes under controlled conditions to reduce moisture and protect the natural spice profile. After drying, we grind the turmeric using food-grade pulverizing equipment. The ground material passes through a controlled sieve to achieve the selected mesh size. For the standard grade, we target turmeric powder 80 mesh. Finally, we inspect the batch, pack it in moisture-resistant materials, and label it for traceability. We can also evaluate spray dried turmeric powder requirements for applications that need improved dispersibility or a specialized powder format. Spray drying, carrier selection, and formulation details depend on the intended use. Buyers should share their process conditions before requesting a final technical recommendation.

Typical Technical Specifications

The following values describe the standard commercial grade. Actual limits may vary by crop, season, destination regulations, and agreed purchase specification. We confirm the final specification before production and dispatch.
  • Mesh size: 80 mesh standard; alternative sizes available by request
  • Moisture: typically not more than 10%
  • Purity: typically 99% minimum, subject to agreed testing parameters
  • Appearance: fine yellow to orange-yellow powder
  • Flavour: warm, earthy, mildly bitter, and characteristic of turmeric
  • Added ingredients: none in the standard additive-free grade
  • Foreign matter: controlled according to the agreed food safety specification
  • Packaging: food-grade, moisture-resistant, and export-suitable formats
We can review additional requirements for curcumin content, microbiological limits, pesticide residue, heavy metals, allergen status, and other destination-market criteria. However, buyers must specify these requirements before quotation. We do not claim certifications or laboratory results unless the relevant documents apply to the supplied batch.

Quality Standards and Documentation

Our quality process begins with raw material selection and continues through packing. We follow documented operating procedures for cleaning, drying, grinding, sieving, inspection, and storage. In addition, we maintain batch identification to support product traceability. Customers may request available product specifications, batch information, packing details, and applicable commercial documents. Certification requirements depend on the customer, product grade, and importing country. Therefore, buyers should identify any required food safety certification, organic documentation, halal or kosher documentation, certificate of analysis, health certificate, or inspection report during the inquiry stage. We confirm availability before making a commitment.

Applications

Turmeric powder supports both traditional recipes and modern industrial formulations. Its colour, aroma, and spice character make it useful in dry and wet systems. Also, its fine particle size helps manufacturers achieve even distribution during mixing.
  • Seasoning blends, curry powders, spice mixes, and masala products
  • Instant noodles, soups, sauces, gravies, and ready-to-cook meals
  • Namkeen, snack coatings, savoury bakery products, and fried snacks
  • Pickles, chutneys, marinades, and processed food recipes
  • Functional beverages, wellness blends, and herbal preparations
  • Private label spice products and retail turmeric packs
  • Food premixes, nutraceutical formulations, and custom ingredient systems

Buyer Value

Wholesale buyers need reliable quality, practical pricing, and predictable supply. Our turmeric powder helps streamline production because it arrives ready for weighing and blending. Moreover, bulk sourcing can reduce handling work and improve procurement efficiency.
  • Cost efficiency through bulk purchasing and scalable supply planning
  • Consistent 80 mesh powder for repeatable mixing performance
  • Long shelf life when sealed and stored under suitable conditions
  • Flexible pack sizes for distributors, manufacturers, and private labels
  • Export support with traceability and shipment documentation review
  • Custom specifications for texture, packaging, and application needs

Packaging and Shelf Life

We pack the product in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Packaging helps protect the powder from humidity, contamination, light, and physical damage. Standard options include 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg packs. We can also discuss bulk bags, export cartons, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, and custom printed packaging. The typical shelf life is 24 months from the manufacturing date when the product remains unopened and stored correctly. The final shelf life depends on the agreed product specification and packaging system. Each package can carry the batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions, and required regulatory information.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Quotation Process

What is the minimum order quantity for turmeric powder wholesale price? Our typical MOQ starts from 100 kg for standard bulk supply. However, the final MOQ depends on product availability, packaging, destination, and order requirements. Private label packaging, customized formulations, and OEM projects may require higher quantities. Lead time usually ranges from 7 to 15 working days after specification, artwork, payment terms, and raw material availability receive approval. Export orders may need additional time for packaging and documentation. Therefore, buyers should share the destination country, required quantity, mesh size, packaging, and target delivery date. To request a sample or quote, send your company details and purchase requirements. Please include the preferred turmeric powder price per kg, annual volume, delivery location, and any required certifications. We then review the request and provide the most suitable commercial and technical proposal. Samples may be available for qualified B2B inquiries, subject to courier and sample policy.

Tradenest Naturals operates as a manufacturer, wholesale supplier, exporter, and food ingredient development partner. We support food processors, FMCG brands, restaurants, importers, and distributors. In addition, our capabilities include grinding, sieving, blending, private label packing, and custom formulation. As a turmeric powder manufacturer India buyers can evaluate, we focus on clear specifications and responsive communication. As a bulk turmeric powder supplier India customers can use for repeat sourcing, we also support practical packaging and export planning. Above all, we aim to build dependable supply relationships through quality control, transparent information, and consistent service.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the standard particle size?

The standard grade uses an 80 mesh sieve. Other mesh sizes may be evaluated for specific applications.

Can you supply turmeric powder?

We can review turmeric powder supplier requirements. Organic status and supporting documents must be confirmed for the specific batch and market.

Can you supply spray dried turmeric powder?

We can assess spray dried turmeric powder requirements. The final formulation depends on carrier, solubility, application, and regulatory needs.

What storage conditions apply?

Store the sealed product in a cool, dry, clean place. Protect it from sunlight, moisture, heat, and strong odours.

How can I obtain a current price?

Send quantity, mesh, packaging, destination, and delivery terms. We will calculate the applicable turmeric powder wholesale price and share a quotation.
